name: Kristian Karlsson
notes: Missed Borussia Dortmund's Tischtennis Bundesliga match at Werder Bremen on 11 November 2026; his teammate Cedric Nuytinck said he had been in pain for a few months and that his return date was not known.

Left out of Sweden's Mixed Team World Cup squad for Chengdu on the ITTF's 26 November 2026 entry list, replaced by Anders Eriksson; no reason was given. He had missed Dortmund's three Bundesliga matches in November.
